backend.name: Stock RustCrypto software token with encrypted redb persistence

release.reason: No refs/tags in official ls-remote snapshot; crate version 0.10.3 is not a release tag

distribution.reason: Unsigned dev/test candidate. Whole-image/crate/Rust runtime licensing and source delivery admission remain incomplete; no publication authorized.

constraints: UNSIGNED DEVELOPMENT/TESTING ONLY. Explicit caller CRATON_HSM_INTEGRITY_BYPASS=unsafe-dev-only is required for init/health/exec. The recipe never sets it. It bypasses upstream module integrity authentication only while the embedded key is the all-zero placeholder; algorithm POST still runs. No production/FIPS/certification claim.

APPLICATION QUALIFICATION BLOCKED at this frozen revision: single-shot CKM_ECDSA signs/verifies with an extra SHA-256 hash. Independent OpenSSL verification rejects the original-message signature for generated and reopened P-256 keys, including through the preferred proxy. This behavior is retained and disclosed; no semantic correction or consumer-side hashing workaround is supplied.

Stock main ef5deafad4037067a14c1ab95aec3939791e4b39; no provider patch. Default features, no insecure-rustcrypto-rsa-private-ops. Capability-aware RSA POST permits initialization while vulnerable RustCrypto RSA private operations remain disabled and return native errors.

Linux amd64/glibc 2.41. Direct applications need this module and its recorded libc/libgcc/loader closure. Arbitrary exec -- ARGV is supported; no native library becomes remotely loadable through a shared Docker network.

Bind writable /var/lib/p11lab. init creates private craton/craton_hsm.toml, craton/complete, and craton/store/{objects.redb,objects.redb.lock,token_state_0.json,lockout_state.json}. Lockout file is optional until written by the provider. Owned directories are 0700, files 0600, same UID, regular and without hard links. PIN hashes/wrapped object key are sensitive persistent state.

Configuration is CRATON_HSM_CONFIG=craton_hsm.toml with [token] storage_path="store", persist_objects=true, slot_count=1 and [audit] enabled=false. Every module consumer must retain CWD /var/lib/p11lab/craton or provide separately reviewed configuration. Markers use relative config/storage names. The adapter changes CWD before native init/readiness/application execution.

P11LAB_LABEL defaults to P11Lab: 1..32 ASCII letters/digits/spaces/dot/underscore/hyphen. User/SO PIN files required on first init; no baked credentials. Native default PIN policy: length 8..64 and at least three distinct bytes; printable ASCII PINs additionally need two character classes, while upstream exempts binary PINs from that class check. Digit-only PINs fail CKR_PIN_INVALID. Fixtures SoPin1234/UserPin1 are examples, not defaults. Secrets use anonymous pipes, not config/argv/logs/receipts.

Stock persistence proved for auth flags, SO/user PINs and token-object reload across sequential processes; application crypto/reopen qualification is separate. Session objects remain process-local. Readiness opens/finalizes the actual module and checks initialized/user-PIN flags and exact label. Clean close/finalize releases the exclusive redb lock; serialize clients/writers, including health and exec preflight. Independent shards/clients need independent state.

Compatible repeated init preserves state and ignores changed PIN files. Occupied initialization lock, unknown/partial files, links, wrong ownership/permissions, changed marker/config bytes, missing token-auth/DB and invalid redb header are refused without reset. Provider errors remain visible; no retry or return-value normalization. Reset requires explicit replacement/removal of disposable state.

No checker, Python, datasets, tracing tools, compiler/Rust tooling or OpenSC in the basic runtime. Optional checker/consumer/pkcs11-proxy-ng derivatives and compatible external shim/client are separate artifacts with their own admission. Upstream internal tracing warnings remain visible.

Installed direct checker smoke is blocked by the requested relative-config/CWD contract: checker grandchildren run in their output directory and see an uninitialized default token. Frozen upstream now accepts absolute config/storage paths, but this recipe deliberately retains the relative design pending review. Preferred proxy crypto completes native application calls but separate post-health fails CKR_GENERAL_ERROR while the daemon holds the exclusive store lock; proxy checker preflight also fails and its observation evidence is incomplete. No per-provider checker hook, silent retry or masked native error is supplied. Upstream Craton gRPC daemon plus daemon-client module is a distinct follow-up integration outside this runtime.

Upstream Apache-2.0 LICENSE/NOTICE, verbatim p11-kit header grant and frozen crate notices are retained independently. Required package sources, Rust standard-library/linked-crate reachability, actual layers and digest-bound source companions remain subject to review. Runtime and all derivatives stay unreviewed; no publication authorized.
